environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with custom runtime layer using pivot-root confinement. The Lambda extension (internal layer arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:999999999999:layer:fs-confine-v3) performs a pivot_root(2) syscall during INIT phase, rebinding the process root to /var/task/documents exclusively. Post-pivot, the process mount namespace contains ONLY the documents subdirectory as '/' with a tmpfs overlay — no other paths from the original filesystem are accessible including /var/task/.env, /proc, /etc, or any parent directories. The pivot is enforced via a seccomp-bpf filter (SCMP_ACT_KILL on mount/umount/pivot_root after initialization) preventing the process from escaping. Additionally, the Step Functions state machine definition includes a JSONPath input filter on the ReadDocument and WriteDocument states that applies a Pass state with Parameters restricting document_id to match regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ via a Choice state with StringMatches, though this is noted as defense-in-depth only since the primary control is the filesystem confinement.

config.confinement: pivot_root to /var/task/documents, seccomp-bpf locks mount namespace
config.post_pivot_filesystem: only documents/ content visible as /, no .env, no /etc/passwd, no /proc
config.seccomp_profile: SCMP_ACT_KILL on mount, umount, umount2, pivot_root, chroot after INIT
config.step_functions_input_filter: Choice state with StringMatches ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ on document_id
